name: Harlan Needs a Resupply
summary: In Stormwind, merchant Harlan Bagley cannot keep sturdy clothes and armor in stock. Demand surges, so he sends an urgent cloth order to Rema Schneider at the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop, unaware of the conflicts brewing beyond the city walls.

sections.title: A Run on Sturdy Clothes
sections.body: Across Stormwind City, Harlan Bagley's shelves empty fast. Citizens and wandering adventurers buy reinforced tunics, traveling clothes, and battle-ready armor. Harlan wonders if they are preparing for a harsh season or winter. The rush leaves his shop short of finished cloth.

sections.title: Questions on the Canals
sections.body: Harlan sends a runner across the city's waterways to Rema Schneider, a seamstress at the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop. She is glad of his trade, yet the sudden demand for protective clothing troubles her. Rumors of tension spread through the kingdom. Rema wonders whether the House of Nobles is hiding talk of open war from ordinary people.

faq.answer: Harlan Bagley is a clothier and shopkeeper in Stormwind City. Local tailors supply the knitted goods and travel-ready clothes he sells.

Rema Schneider is a professional tailor and seamstress at the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop in Stormwind. With her husband Corbett, she supplies merchants across the city with freshly sewn fabric and garments.

faq.q: Why is Harlan running out of clothing?
faq.answer: Citizens and travelers are buying armor and rugged clothes in unusually high numbers. Harlan jokes that they seem to expect a bitter winter, though rising unrest and danger across the kingdom's borders are the true cause.

faq.q: Why does Rema Schneider suspect the nobles?
faq.answer: Rema finds it strange that ordinary people are suddenly preparing for battle without an official declaration of conflict. The House of Nobles controls royal affairs while King Varian Wrynn is absent. She fears the nobles are concealing an impending war from the public.

faq.q: Where is the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop located?
faq.answer: The Canal Tailor and Fit Shop lies along the waterways that run through Stormwind City, between the major city districts for convenient merchant deliveries.

faq.q: What happens after the cloth request is delivered?
faq.answer: After Rema receives the order, she asks her husband Corbett Schneider to carry another load of knitted goods across the city to Harlan at the Lionheart Armory. On his way back to the shop, Corbett stops at Trias' Cheese for a snack.

angles.text: Stormwind's canal workshops supply larger shops, showing the everyday workings of the city's textile trade.
Stormwind's shoppers show growing unease in the Alliance heartland while King Varian Wrynn is absent.
Stormwind's working artisans distrust their rulers and suspect the nobility is keeping ordinary people in the dark about looming dangers.
